name: Dire Maul: Zevrim Thornhoof never sacrifices a tank and healer duo
contract: Zevrim Thornhoof 11490 is a Dire Maul (map 429, expansion 0) encounter boss. His SmartAI casts Sacrifice 22651 at
a random hostile within 30 yd (event 1, first after 3-10 s, then every 15-21 s), and his Ascension kit casts
Sacrifice 2100215 at a random player (event 9001, first after 9.75-11.75 s, then every 30-32 s). Both teleport
the target to his altar (spell_target_position 22651), stun it and drain it. Vanilla dungeon boss control spells,
Sacrifice included, never take a tank or healer specialization (BossControlTargeting.h); with nobody else to
take, they are not cast. Vanguard 21 tanks, Grovekeeper 58 heals and Boltslinger 10 deals damage. The fight is at
the East Wing east entrance (areatrigger_teleport 3185), 92 yd from the nearest spawn. With only a tank and a
healer there is no eligible target, so neither Sacrifice is cast. The players are level 57 humans, matching the
boss, so its spells land at their normal hit chance. They group in Stormwind and teleport into one instance,
where the boss is summoned at its own stats; player health fixtures keep everyone alive through the window.
Sacrifice 22651 (event 1) has event_flags 16 and never runs in a 5-player dungeon; the Ascension Sacrifice
2100215 is the live one, and the scenario asserts neither is cast. A control requires the boss to keep casting
Shadow Word: Pain 2100262 through the same window, so the 'never cast' result cannot come from an idle or broken

steps.label: Let the characters finish logging in
CONTROL: tank is inside the dungeon
CONTROL: healer is inside the dungeon
Summon the boss in the group's instance
Let the boss's spawn events settle
The tank engages first and keeps top threat
The tank builds a threat lead
Run through both Sacrifice windows and a repeat
CONTROL: Zevrim is still fighting the group
CONTROL: the boss's AI keeps casting (Shadow Word: Pain 2100262)
Zevrim never casts Sacrifice without a damage dealer
Zevrim never casts the Ascension Sacrifice without a damage dealer
